signature.one_line: Selfie breakdown: top proof window over accent divider, plain captions, accelerating screenshot montage.
unique_devices: Persistent split: proof window in the top 35 %, 8 px accent #FDF677 divider, face in the bottom 65 %; the top window swaps every ~25-50 frames while the face holds
Proof screenshots in accent-bordered cards on a light-grey panel instead of full-frame B-roll
Late proof montage of rounded full-screen post captures on light grey, accelerating to ~60 cuts/min before a full-face payoff
Plain white semibold captions with no emphasis, locked at 80.3 % H on every layout
signature.why_it_works: The face keeps the explanation personal while the top window delivers fast visual proof; the accelerating montage makes the claim feel overwhelming before the question CTA.

hook.first_frame: full-frame front-camera close-up of the speaker against warm practical lights, splitting within ~25 frames into proof window over face

structure.what: surprising money claim + promise to explain how; split screen with the top window swapping every ~30 frames
reframe: what everyone thinks vs what is really going on
screenshot cards of profiles as evidence; full-face line introducing the 3-step model
step 1 / step 2 of the framework with thumbnail cards and stage clips in the top window
full-screen post-capture montage at 8-75 frames per card, revenue-share numbers spoken

captions.how: 2-4 words, Inter 600 65 px white, +0.02 em, soft shadow 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.5), centred at 80.3 % H, max ~66 % W; hard cut on/off, 4-5 empty frames between sentences

cards_lists.how: light-grey #EAEADE top panel, screenshot x 7-95 % / y 6-27 % with ~6 px accent border; face continues below
light-grey #DADEE4 ground, rounded card x 7-93 % / y 7-90 %, original UI kept; 8-75 frames each, accelerating; 44 % soft swaps

broll_inserts.how: short clips / stills fill the top 35 %, swapped every ~25-50 frames (the swaps are not counted as cuts)

layout.what: stacked split screen with accent divider
layout.how: B-roll 0-35 % H, 8 px accent bar at 35.1-35.5 %, selfie CU 35.5-100 %

camera.what: static front camera with jump-cut reframes
camera.how: no animated punch-ins; every breath cut (0 pauses)

transitions.what: hard cuts + soft swaps between proof cards
transitions.how: 44 % soft swaps (short dissolves) between cards; hard cuts elsewhere, half of them on audio hits

case.caption: sentence case as spoken (capital at sentence start and for proper names)

captions_spec.punctuation: full stop kept at sentence ends; numbers as digits with % when spoken as figures

grouping.sync: per phrase; the caption appears whole
grouping.break: at phrase/sentence boundaries; a 4-5 frame empty gap between sentences

layout.note: identical position on the split-screen talking head, on the yellow-bordered screenshot layout and on full-screen rounded reel captures

caption.font_class: neo-grotesque sans, semibold (single-storey g, flat-topped t, phone-system-UI-like)
caption.size_note: reference 4-word line (~23 characters) measured ink 3.12 % H / ~62 % W at 65 px; a 4-word sentence with a full stop ~56 % W

animation.entry: hard cut on (0 -> full ink in one frame), no fade / scale / slide
animation.timing: per phrase; at sentence starts the caption comes ~8 frames after the spoken word start; mid-sentence chunks follow each other directly
animation.exit: hard cut off; 4-5 empty frames before the next sentence's caption

other_text_spec.text: top B-roll window 0-35 % of H, separated from the talking head by a solid yellow #FDF677 bar at 35.1-35.5 % (~8 px at 1920)
social-profile / video-thumbnail screenshot with a ~6 px yellow #EBE97E border, x 7-95 %, y 6-27 % (estimated); text inside is the captured UI
rounded-corner (radius ~3 % W) short-video capture x 7-93 %, y 7-90 % keeping its original handles, stickers and timer; captions stay at 80.3 %

style.look_intent: high-contrast, natural-saturation, warm; front-camera look with warm practical lights, soft contrast on skin

sfx: no music; half of the hard cuts land on audio hits (measured cut_hit_share 0.5) - optional soft swipe on card swaps

sound.method: heuristic (onset-envelope beat periodicity + level in speech gaps); not a classifier

brand_prompt:
Use /video-pipeline with /video-captions on videos/<project>. Apply style blueprint B33 (video-reference-match/references/blueprints/B33.json) to this brand.

BRAND TOKENS (use the brand's colour for each role; keep the contrast relationship — text and accent must stay >= 4.5:1 / >= 3:1 against what sits behind them on the footage):
- {{TEXT}}      default #FFFFFF (captions)
- {{ACCENT}}    default #FDF677 (split divider bar)
- {{ACCENT_2}}  default #EBE97E (screenshot card border)
- {{SURFACE}}   default #EAEADE (light-grey panel behind screenshot cards)
- {{CARD_BG}}   default #DADEE4 (light-grey ground behind full-screen post captures)
- {{FONT_DISPLAY}} default Inter 600
- {{FONT_BODY}}    default Inter 600
- {{HANDLE}}    default @handle
- {{LOGO}}      default the brand's logo file (transparent PNG/SVG)
Divider and border are chrome, not text: keep them clearly visible (>= 3:1) against both the B-roll and the face below.
Canvas 1080x1920, 25 fps (scale frame counts if the project fps differs).

CAPTIONS
1. Roman script / English as spoken, sentence case (capitals at sentence starts and for names); full stops at sentence ends; numbers as digits. No emoji, no key-word colour.
2. One line of 2-4 words per caption, whole phrase at once; break at phrase / sentence boundaries.
3. Type: {{FONT_BODY}} at 65 px, {{TEXT}}, tracking +0.02 em, no stroke / box, soft drop shadow 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.5). Centred, ink centre at 80.3 % H, max ~66 % W. Same position on every layout.
4. Animation: none — hard cut on, hard cut off. Mid-sentence chunks replace each other directly; 4-5 empty frames between sentences; sentence-start captions may land ~8 frames after the spoken word.

OTHER TEXT / LAYOUT
5. Split screen while talking (~54 % of runtime): B-roll window 0-35 % H, talking head below, separated by a solid {{ACCENT}} bar 8 px tall at 35.1-35.5 % H. Swap the top visual every ~25-50 frames in the hook.
6. Screenshot proof: {{SURFACE}} panel in the top third with the screenshot framed by a ~6 px {{ACCENT_2}} border, x 7-95 %, y 6-27 %.
7. Post-capture montage (~65-91 % of runtime): full-screen {{CARD_BG}} with each capture in a rounded card (radius ~3 % W), x 7-93 %, y 7-90 %, original UI kept; 8-75 frames per card, accelerating; ~44 % short soft swaps. Captions stay on top at 80.3 %.
8. Payoff: back to full-frame face for the last ~9 % with a comment question. No {{LOGO}} or end card ({{HANDLE}} optional).

GRADE
Grade from the user's footage (video-style / grade.py); target look: high-contrast, natural-saturation, warm front-camera look.

VERIFY before rendering
a) Render a test caption 'KEY WORD here now' and measure: python3 video-reference-match/scripts/caption_probe.py <test-render> --out <dir> --at <t> --box 0.08,0.765,0.92,0.835 --ink "{{TEXT}}:50"
b) python3 video-reference-match/scripts/fit_font.py --font "Inter 600" --word "<line with ascenders and descenders>" --ink 3.12 --tracking 0.02 -> ~64-65 px; a ~23-character 4-word line reads ~62 % W. Tolerance ±0.5 % H, ±2 % W; measure over dark clothing. (fit_font.py needs a target: --ink and/or --width; it returns the px that reproduces that ink for YOUR word plus the width it will read at that px. Requires Pillow.)
c) Positions within ±1 % H: caption centre 80.3 %, divider 35.1-35.5 %.
